identity.description: An attacker uses wscript/cscript to load .NET assemblies from a remote location, mimicking legitimate .NET execution patterns. Cortex should detect this behavior as suspicious when .NET DLLs are loaded by script hosts.

techniques.name: Command and Scripting Interpreter: Visual Basic

manual_steps: Not authored. Write and test cleanup before promotion.

biocs.name: Wscript/Cscript loads .NET DLL
biocs.description: Detection of wscript.exe or cscript.exe loading .NET DLLs
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name in ('wscript.exe', 'cscript.exe')
| filter action_file_path contains '.dll'
| filter action_file_path contains '.NET'

abiocs.name: Suspicious .NET DLL Load via Script Host
abiocs.description: Behavioral deviation where script hosts (wscript/cscript) load .NET DLLs from non-standard paths
abiocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name in ('wscript.exe', 'cscript.exe')
| filter action_file_path contains '.dll'
| filter action_file_path not in ('C:\\Windows\\Microsoft.NET\\', 'C:\\Windows\\System32\\')

xql_queries.name: Detect .NET DLL Load by Script Host
xql_queries.query:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name in ('wscript.exe', 'cscript.exe')
| filter action_file_path contains '.dll'
| filter action_file_path contains '.NET'
| comp count() by actor_process_image_name, action_file_path
